{{Quote|It was a formidable fight but the slavers' ship was not built to withstand an attack from a swarm of TIEs.|[[Tvrrdko]]|<ref name="Chewbacca" />}}
A '''skirmish''' occurred when the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Flanchard]]'' intercepted a [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] starship near [[Komnor]].<ref name="TEGtW" /> However, the ship had been boarded just before by [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. The Wookiee killed all the slavers and freed the Wookiee prisoners. The slaver ship was under control of the Wookiees when Imperial forces arrived in the area. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his squadron of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] disabled the enemy starship but the Wookiees managed to escape in another transport during the battle. Solo only found Chewbacca and dead slavers when he boarded the slaver ship.<ref name="Chewbacca" /> Han Solo refused to execute the Wookiee as ordered by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Pter Nyklas|Nyklas]] and was reprimanded by his superiors. Grounded on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for a while, Solo rescued the enslaved Chewbacca and both tried to flee the planet together. They failed and Han Solo was definitely expelled from the Imperial Navy.<ref name="TEGtW" />
